calculator_engine: function balanceTransfer(outstanding,oldRate,newRate,years,processFee){const r_old=oldRate/100/12;const r_new=newRate/100/12;const n=years*12;function emi(p,r){return p*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);}const oldEMI=emi(outstanding,r_old);const newEMI=emi(outstanding,r_new);const monthlySaving=oldEMI-newEMI;const totalSaving=monthlySaving*n-processFee;const breakeven=processFee/monthlySaving;return{oldEMI,newEMI,monthlySaving,totalSaving,breakeven:breakeven.toFixed(0)};}
